business_rules.title: Per-entity control-number types
business_rules.statement: GeneLot=9, GeneLotPlant=10, SeedExperiment=11, SeedLot=12, SeedLotPlant=14, GermLot(GNBR)=15.

business_rules.title: Cull is immutable
business_rules.statement: cullGeneLot/cullSeedExperiment return NEW frozen objects with isCulled=true; originals never mutated.

business_rules.title: SeedLot requires donor + target lineage
business_rules.statement: Creating a SeedLot requires both targetGeneLotId and donorGeneLotId; the service verifies both exist.

business_rules.title: CloneLot.numberOfClones decrement
business_rules.statement: Spec: creating a gene lot from a clone lot decrements clone_lot.number_of_clones by N. cloneLotRepo is now injected, but the decrement is not yet applied.

business_rules.title: ChemocodeFuser
business_rules.statement: Spec: fuse chemotype data onto gene lots (ChemocodeFuser). Not implemented.

connectors.name: Seam 1 — Control-Number authority
connectors.trigger: Any context mints a traceable record
connectors.effect: A single immutable control number ({prefix}{YYMMDD}-{genocode}, 18 type codes) is issued and never edited/deleted

connectors.name: Seam 4 — Genocode / product master authority
connectors.effect: Genocode is the authority; product-master unifies the legacy batch.Product + SpecProduct models
